description: Curated Hinglish customer reviews across Smartphones, Audio, Laptops, Footwear, and Clothing. Explicitly annotated with aspect spans, opinion spans, polarities, span languages, and derived pair types.
data_collection_method: Multi-annotator agreement protocol with cross-lingual span alignment
annotation_protocol: Guidelines require exact span containment in review_text, span-level language tagging (English, Hindi, Mixed, Uncertain), and deterministic pair-type derivation.
